نجتور (form VIII)
# نَجْتَوِرُ (najtawiru) /nad͡ʒ.ta.wi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَوَرَ (ijtawara)
# نَجْتَوِرَ (najtawira) /nad͡ʒ.ta.wi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَوَرَ (ijtawara)
# نَجْتَوِرْ (najtawir) /nad͡ʒ.ta.wir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْتَوَرَ (ijtawara)
